summary: Cycle 2. The broker refused two of my cycle-2 actions because they targeted only residues already satisfied: the bake (plays-clean) and the linter update (route-complete). It also refused git-state.js as already executed; that was a framework flaw, now fixed with content fingerprints in the idempotency key (test 15). So the game ran the old bundle: the ladder count stayed 0 and the objective clock was still capped. Meanwhile mods/ holds the 110 px hatches, which the old linter's 40 px ladder reach can't join, so route-complete regressed. The probe fixes did take: boat-run, boat-returns (1979 px), patrols-drive (2 moved) and respawn-works are now satisfied. Frame ratio 2.88 on the same old bundle (2.13 before) shows how noisy the software renderer's timing is.

claims.text: The installed bundle predates the ladder and objective fixes: onLadder never appears (0 throughout) and the objective still stalls at about 10%.
route-complete regressed: the mod's hatches are 110 px, but the installed linter still joins ladders only to floors within 40 px.
The boat now boards from its deck, runs east under the caps, and backs 1979 px west. Two patrols moved under autopilot.
The frame ratio reads 2.88 against 2.13 last cycle on the same bundle, so this measurement is noisy by about ±0.4.
Re-issue the bake and the linter targeting open residues (ladders-work, three-chunks), and ship the three-chunk level with the probes updated for it.
